title: DecisionQualityAuditInput
description: Input for decision quality audit of a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad audit of all decisions surfaced) or transcript + context (targeted audit of a specific decision with strategic background, participant directory, and risk tolerance). All optional fields improve audit quality when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough content for meaningful decision quality analysis (minimum 100 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-confidence output.

meeting_title.description: Title or subject of the meeting. Helps contextualize decisions. Example: 'APAC Expansion Planning — Week 12'.

meeting_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of when the meeting occurred. Used to normalize relative deadlines and anchor temporal references.

decision_focus.description: A specific decision to audit. When provided, the analysis centers on this decision's quality rather than scanning all decisions in the transcript. Example: 'Launch Singapore as lead APAC market with Japan as phased follow-on'.

strategic_context.description: Organizational or strategic background that helps interpret decision quality: company stage, competitive pressures, board expectations, recent pivots. Example: 'Series B SaaS company; board expects international revenue by Q4 for Series C narrative.'.

risk_tolerance.description: Organization's risk tolerance level. Adjusts how aggressively the audit flags gaps and underweighted risks. 'low' = flag everything, 'high' = only flag material gaps.

analysis_depth.description: Controls analysis thoroughness. 'quick' = high-level score and top gaps only. 'standard' = full audit with assumptions and accountability. 'deep' = exhaustive analysis with maximum evidence citation.

participant_directory.description: Known participants to seed owner and accountability resolution. The auditor will still discover additional participants from the transcript.

name.description: Full name of the participant as they appear in the transcript.

role.description: Job title or organizational role. Example: 'VP Engineering', 'Product Lead'.

team.description: Team, department, or business unit. Example: 'Platform', 'Product', 'Finance'.

key_questions.description: Specific questions the audit should address. Each should be a concrete concern about decision quality. Example items: 'Did we consider the compliance risk before committing?', 'Were alternatives to the phased rollout discussed?'.
